content.comment_body: Hi, is there a way to halt the [product_name] program if no input signal arrives within a certain time? If so, which function block should be used? Thanks in advance. [user_name]
It is not possible to stop the program using a designated stop command. The [product_name] does not offer such a block. To interrupt the program flow, you need to design your logic accordingly.

An electrical interlock could be implemented to control power to the [product_name]. For example, pressing a button activates a relay that supplies power to the [product_name], which remains active until one of its outputs is switched on. However, there are some considerations: 1) The [product_name] may take noticeable time to restart. 2) According to the manual, more details about your use case would help. Is your goal energy conservation, such as when the [product_name] is powered by a battery?
